description: Synthetic, committed fixtures for local development. No real customer data, credential, mailbox, API key or paid service is involved.

determinism.rule: Seeding the same fixtures into two different isolated roots must produce byte-identical manifests.
determinism.why: A development root that varies between runs cannot support reproducible debugging or a believable diff.
guarantees: No timestamp, hostname, username, absolute path, random value or process id is written into any seeded file.
Manifest entries are sorted by path.
Fixtures are copied verbatim from committed files, never generated at seed time.
Two roots seeded from the same commit are equal byte for byte, and neither is derived from the other.

isolation.rule: The seed loader must never write to a path that could hold real application data.
how: A data root must resolve inside the OS temporary directory.
Roots inside the repository, the home directory, or APPDATA are rejected unconditionally.
The temporary-directory rule has no override; the OS temporary directory itself is refused.
Existing nonempty roots are accepted only when all four seeded files match exactly; symlinks and unrelated files are refused. Every seeded root carries a .avencrew-fixture-root marker file.

notIncluded: No database schema, migration or journal. crates/store-sqlite intentionally has no table definitions yet (P2 work).
No model execution, provider call, harness turn or tool dispatch. Nothing here can spend money.
No cloud service, remote worker or supervisor process.
No claim that any run, task, receipt or artifact succeeded.
No business scenario data beyond the wire examples. The cross-functional oracles in docs/implementation/fixtures/ specify future tests; their bytes are P3-01.
verification: Seed into two separate isolated roots and compare manifests byte for byte; they must be identical.
Attempt to seed into the repository, the home directory and a simulated application data root; each must be refused with a nonzero exit.
Confirm no network access is required and no API key is read.
